title: Otel Genai Conventions
motto: OpenTelemetry's GenAI SIG (launched April 2024) defines the standard schema for agent telemetry. Span names, attributes, and content-capture rules converge across vendors so agent traces mean the same thing in Datadog, Grafana, Jaeger, and Honeycomb.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: OpenTelemetry's GenAI SIG (launched April 2024) defines the standard schema for agent telemetry. Span names, attributes, and content-capture rules converge across vendors so agent traces mean the same thing in Datadog, Grafana, Jaeger, and Honeycomb.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Every vendor invents their own span names. Ops teams end up building per-framework dashboards. OpenTelemetry's GenAI SIG fixes this by defining one standard the whole ecosystem targets.
